page_title: NAP 1-3 FIO | Napoli v Fiorentina 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.

90+3' 1 - 3 Goal! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the top right corner. Fabiano Parisi assisted in the goal. 1:3.
90+1' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
89' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card for infringement.
89' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Jonathan Ikone is replaced by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
86' Giovanni Di Lorenzo swings the cross over. Mathias Olivera (Napoli) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
85' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
83' It will be a substitution. Gino Infantino (Fiorentina) is ready to enter the pitch as Arthur Melo walks off.
83' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) replacing Alfred Duncan.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Kayode departs the field of play to be replaced by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina).
80' Napoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Giovanni Simeone wasn't able to finish and lost the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Napoli.
78' Good chance! Alfred Duncan laid the ball off to Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli) replaces Stanislav Lobotka.
77' It is time for a substitution. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is on for Victor Osimhen.
76' Rudi Garcia has decided to substitute Piotr Zielinski and he is replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
73' That will be all from Josip Brekalo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina).
70' What was Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
69' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
68' 11:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:2.
63' 1 - 2 Goal! Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:2.
61' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
60' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

60' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.

59' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Pietro Terracciano inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the right side of the target, but was denied by a great save.
57' The game has come to an end for Matteo Politano. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jens Cajuste (Napoli).

57' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post.
56' Fiorentina take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.
55' The resulting corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) launches a cross from the corner, but Pietro Terracciano is alert to thwart the effort.

54' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
52' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Piotr Zielinski, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar.
52' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) will take a corner kick.
51' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
49' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Pietro Terracciano into right side of the goal.
45+5' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+4' Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
45+4' Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina) brings his opponent down. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Napoli!
45+2' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+1' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' The resulting corner, taken by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina), comes to nothing.
44' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
41' A cross from Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) receives a reproachful look from Matteo Politano. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
38' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
37' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
32' Rudi Garcia is forced to make a change. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is unable to continue due to injury, Giacomo Raspadori comes on.
31' It doesn’t look good for Frank Anguissa (Napoli); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
30' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

29' The fans were almost celebrating as Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Pietro Terracciano made an astonishing save!
25' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Napoli players look gutted.
23' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Federico La Penna wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
22' A goal, which was scored by Victor Osimhen (Napoli), was disallowed due to offside.
18' The free kick from long range, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

18' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Federico La Penna blows his whistle for an infringement. Napoli earn a free kick.
14' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
11' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
7' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.
6' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
6' CHANCE! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Matteo Politano.
5' The ball squirts out to Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) inside the box, and his first-time drive beats the keeper but fails to find the net as it's amazingly blocked on the line by a defender.
4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Federico La Penna blows for a foul. Fiorentina will take a free kick.
2' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Federico La Penna.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
